slides.title: Qatar talks to end Gulf war
slides.image_prompt: Oil tanker in a calm narrow strait at dusk, a heavy chain stretched across the water beginning to lower, warm golden light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran met Qatari mediators in Doha to end the Gulf war.
WHY IT MATTERS
Iran says Hormuz could reopen in 2 days if the US agrees.
FOR YOU
No deal yet: Rubio gave no timeframe, and Trump says he's in no hurry.

slides.title: Oleshky evacuees reach Ukraine
slides.image_prompt: A single bus driving along a long country road at sunrise, open fields on both sides, hopeful warm light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Hundreds evacuated from occupied Oleshky reached Ukraine via Belarus.
WHY IT MATTERS
About 2,000 still there could leave or get new supplies.
FOR YOU
A rare bit of good news: families who wanted out got a route.

🗳️ US midterms are Tuesday, after record early voting. What happens next with Iran may hang on the vote.
